name: Brotli

source.verification: A tag source archive generated by GitHub, so there is no release asset digest or upstream signature (v1.1.1 has no release assets and no commit signature). Confirmed through the GitHub API that the git blob hashes of all 135 files in the archive match tree fc76b80f12b03e6fff3328a2e904ff94f354880a of tag v1.1.1 commit db0631dfea829194206d269bc7b25d0908cdb97d (the other 232 files are upstream .gitattributes export-ignore and are not in the archive). Compared with the v1.1.0 archive (sha256 e720a6ca29428b803f4ad165371771f5398faba397edf6778837a18599ea13ff, the same value as the Homebrew brotli 1.1.0 formula), only 4 files differ: CHANGELOG.md, c/common/version.h, c/dec/decode.c and c/include/brotli/decode.h.

notes: Version: the request was 1.1.0, but 1.1.1 is used. 1.1.1 is a patch release that only adds a decoder security fix (CVE-2026-111497: decode.c did not report an invalid block switch as an error, allowing out-of-bounds writes; upstream commit da98063 "Detect and report invalid stream earlier") and the version bump. The public API is the same, and decode.h gains the error code BROTLI_DECODER_ERROR_FORMAT_BLOCK_SWITCH (-17).

Only the decoder is imported: all .c and .h of c/common, all of c/dec, and decode.h, port.h, shared_dictionary.h and types.h of c/include/brotli. The encoder (c/enc, encode.h), tools (c/tools), other language bindings and test data are not included. Like Godot Compression, only decompression is supported (WOFF2 fonts and the like).

Allocation: the adapter passes both Rocks Allocator-backed functions to BrotliDecoderCreateInstance(alloc_func, free_func, opaque), so every allocation of the decoder state, ring buffer, Huffman tables and shared dictionary state goes through them. The CRT path used when no allocation functions are given remains in the object, but it is never executed when both functions are passed: BrotliDefaultAllocFunc and BrotliDefaultFreeFunc in platform.c and the BrotliDecoderStateInit branch in state.c that selects them, the malloc and free branch of BrotliDecoderCreateInstance in decode.c, and the malloc branch of BrotliSharedDictionaryCreateInstance in shared_dictionary.c. The public one-shot API BrotliDecoderDecompress always uses the default allocator, so the adapter never calls it. Upstream has no configuration point that removes this path at compile time (Docs/Design/Compression.ko.md section 13.2). The built-in dictionary (dictionary.c) is static data.

No definitions: without BROTLI_SHARED_COMPILATION, BROTLI_DEC_API and BROTLI_COMMON_API are empty and internal symbols (BROTLI_INTERNAL) are hidden on the GNU family. The 37 external symbols have the Brotli, kBrotli and _kBrotli prefixes and do not collide with zstd, LZ4 or zlib symbols (checked with llvm-nm). External headers are included only through the brotli/ subpath, so their names do not collide either.
Large window (BROTLI_DECODER_PARAM_LARGE_WINDOW, a nonstandard extension) is not enabled. The standard window is at most 16MiB, and WOFF2 and HTTP Content-Encoding use only the standard window.

The 5 _Pragma uses in platform.h are inline directives for the TI, IAR and PGI compilers (BROTLI_INLINE and BROTLI_NOINLINE), not diagnostic directives. They are not used in the clang and GCC branches.
